data.motivesAndTactics: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger

features.name: Headbutt
features.text: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals **1d12+2** physical damage instead of its standard damage.

features.name: Bolt
features.text: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.
